689:t_016:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You've served in a manner worthy of the name $$真徒$$. To reward you, I shall show you a miracle.」

689:t_016:6.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It is precisely because I can do that that I bear the name $$御使い$$.」

689:t_016:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I shall show you that power as well.」

689:t_017:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「My will to resist... is fading...」

689:t_017:3.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Is this... the power of that man called $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...?」

689:t_017:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「No. This is awe.」

689:t_017:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Faced with overwhelming... absolute power, people stop thinking in their helplessness and simply shed tears to beg for mercy...」

689:t_017:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「This is engraved in your genes... In that sense, a $$烙印$$ is engraved in all of humanity.」

689:t_017:10.en:
$$トライア$$
「So you really were the ones engraving the $$烙印$$...!」

689:t_017:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You can no longer resist. You can only obey my words.」

689:t_017:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You bastard...! This... is practically hypnosis...!」

689:t_017:13.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It's useless. Even Reactors are not permitted to defy my will.」

689:t_017:14.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Surely you can see that just by looking at $n?」

689:t_017:16.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But there is no need to worry. From now on, you will act as my hands and feet, working to save the universe.」

689:t_017:17.en:
$n
「Like... hell... I'll obey... words like that...」

689:t_017:18.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No... My consciousness... is already... slip...ping... away.........」

689:t_049:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's get fired up today too...!」

689:t_049:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But I can move my body!」

689:t_049:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I placed suggestions on all of you in case of an emergency.」

689:t_049:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You take a specific action in response to a keyword... Once that circuit was formed, the rest was easy. Now you will move as I instruct.」

689:t_049:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You mean that routine at the $$Ｄトレーダー$$!」

689:t_049:14.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I can't believe he conditioned all of us without our knowing...」

689:t_049:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It was hard work getting you all to say the keywords of your own accord.」

689:t_049:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「After all, I couldn't engrave the $$バインドスペル$$ unless I lowered your psychological resistance.」

689:t_049:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But by taking my time, I succeeded in letting it sink in deeply and quietly. A sudden miracle is no match for it.」

689:t_049:18.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The $$バインドスペル$$... The suggestion used to control Brigadier General $$エーデル・ベルナル$$ in $$ＵＣＷ$$...」

689:t_049:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There's no need to worry anymore. From now on, I will be the one controlling you.」

689:t_049:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It pains me as well, but it's better than becoming the $$御使い$$s' puppets, isn't it?」

689:t_049:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your anger toward God's emissary... and my meticulous preparations brought about this great reversal.」

689:t_049:23.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$ isn't the only one we're angry at!」

689:t_049:24.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We're angry at you too, $$ＡＧ$$!」

689:t_049:25.en:
$$竜馬$$
「How dare you pull a stunt like controlling our minds!」

689:t_049:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... Aah... If you get so angry, the $$バインドスペル$$'s effect will...!」

689:t_018:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Thanks to you, that sort of thing will never work on us again!」

689:t_018:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let me be clear: this isn't the power of your $$バインドスペル$$!」

689:t_018:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You made us angry... That's the power behind it.」

689:t_018:4.en:
$$キリコ$$
「We won't obey you. Or the $$御使い$$s.」

689:t_018:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Y-You say that, but the only person whose $$バインドスペル$$ I haven't registered seems to still be in trouble...」

689:t_018:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're as much trouble as ever!」

689:t_018:9.en:
$$カレン$$
「Pull yourself together, $n! You've got a big job waiting for you now, don't you!?」

689:t_018:10.en:
$$甲児$$
「Hurry up! $$クロウ$$, $$ランド$$, and $$セツコ$$ are waiting!」

689:t_018:13.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「It's all right now, $n. Let's be enveloped by Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ together.」

689:t_018:15.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「You're the one who should be quiet. $n belongs to me and Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.」

689:t_019:0.en:
$n
「The life Mom protected, Dad and Sis nurtured, and my friends supported belongs to me!」

689:t_019:1.en:
$n
「I won't hand over who I am to anyone!」

689:t_019:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「It has to be now! Synchronize the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ and the $$スフィア$$s!」
